title: Best gynecologists in Buenos Aires for young women

methodology.note: Public-evidence ranking of CABA gynecologists for young, non-pregnant women. Score is annual exam, contraception, HPV/STI, and menstrual/PCOS/endometriosis fit first. Medifé is a badge and filter only — it does not change the score. Fertility-, pregnancy-, and oncology-first practices were dropped.

weights.name: Young-woman fit
weights.note: Published contraception (IUD/implant/pills), PAP/colposcopy, HPV/STI, first-visit framing, PCOS, endometriosis. Deduct if the public practice is pregnancy, fertility, menopause, or oncology first.

weights.name: Credentials
weights.note: Specialist title, hospital staff (Alemán, Italiano, Británico, Finochietto, Otamendi, CEMIC, Austral), SOGIBA or teaching.

weights.name: Review signal
weights.note: Doctoralia plus Google volume and rating. Volume cannot outrank a better clinical fit.

weights.name: Transparency
weights.note: Confirmable address, booking path, named services, and published prices.

weights.name: Experience
weights.note: Years in practice, teaching, or publications.

validation.source: Spanish-first discovery across Doctoralia CABA/Medifé/DIU/primera-consulta lists, TopDoctors, SAE endometriosis map, Hospital Alemán, Italiano, Británico, CEMIC, Finochietto, Otamendi, AMAdA/SAGIJ, then one research pass per candidate.
validation.scope: CABA gynecologists whose public offering includes routine non-pregnant care. Curated shortlist, not a directory of every consultorio or hospital staff name.

doctors.name: Dra. Mónica Graciela Heredia
doctors.fullAddress: Riobamba 1040 Piso 1 Dto 1, Recoleta, C1116 CABA
doctors.bestFor: IUD and implant, PAP/colposcopy, and a first annual exam.
doctors.notes: UBA teacher and Rivadavia staff since 1987. Ran that hospital’s family-planning clinic for 15 years and co-founded AMAdA. OSDE and private; English listed.
doctors.caution: No Medifé listing. Hospital title is now reproductive endocrinology, so confirm you want routine care, not fertility workup.

doctors.name: Dra. Iara Victoria Cortese
doctors.fullAddress: Centro Médico Ginecológico, Av. Luis María Campos 559, piso 5, Palermo, CABA 1426
doctors.bestFor: First visit, Mirena/copper IUD, implant, PAP/HPV, and endometriosis workup.
doctors.notes: Private Las Cañitas office with published prices (first visit $55,000). Hospital Militar / Clínicas / Méndez staff. English confirmed in reviews.
doctors.caution: Medifé is reimbursement (Plan Oro), not cartilla. Complex surgery may be referred out.

doctors.name: Dra. María Sol Cabrera
doctors.fullAddress: Segurola 2127, Devoto Centro Médico, Villa Devoto, C1417 CABA
doctors.bookingLead: Doctoralia or Devoto Centro Médico WhatsApp.
doctors.bestFor: Annual exam, IUD/implant, PAP/HPV, and a first visit in western CABA.
doctors.notes: UBA 2011. Ramos Mejía staff and former chief resident. Published private prices (first visit from $17,000; PAP listed free). English listed. Reviews mention annual exams and first visits.
doctors.caution: No Medifé — OSDE and private only. Also trained in prenatal ultrasound; confirm you want routine gynecology.

doctors.notes: Hospital Alemán gynecology staff. UBA teacher. Colposcopy-accredited. Public profile is genital-tract infections and cervical pathology, not obstetrics.

doctors.name: Dra. Lucia Domingo
doctors.bookingLead: Doctoralia at the Caballito office, or WhatsApp.
